ext_description.message: Paste a link, get a timestamped transcript — searchable, click-to-jump, ad-skip. YouTube, podcasts, articles. Fully local, no API calls.

url_placeholder.message: YouTube, podcast RSS, Apple Podcasts, article…

error_no_result.message: No entry ID in the URL.

error_result_not_found.message: This entry was not found (it may have been deleted, or the extension was reloaded).

library_empty.message: Nothing saved yet. Fetch a link from the popup.

footer_note.message: Works for YouTube, podcast RSS/Apple Podcasts feeds with a transcript tag, and article pages. No API key needed, nothing is sent anywhere — everything stays in this browser.
